title: What a way to kick off the Barcelona City Tour!
text:
As the title of the tour points out, this walking tour is tailored for families with children and with that, the expectation will always be that the tour guide will need to give at least some attentions to the kids joining the tour. 
Our verdict? Montse exceeded our expectation by miles as she managed to mix the interaction between adults and children equally whilst managing to effortlessly entertain the 6 and 4 years old girls with enthusiasm which made the kids enjoyed walking tour even more, jet-lagged notwithstanding, that was.
